purpose: Shared facts-only input policy for E1 and E2. It is frozen before E1 fitting and must not be tuned after test evaluation.
rule: Retain text before the earlier of: (a) the earliest matching closing-section header or dispositive cue, or (b) 60% of source characters. If a preceding sentence end occurs after at least 240 retained characters, move the cut back to that sentence end; otherwise cut exactly at the selected boundary. Every selected boundary is logged in validation.
known_limitation: ILDC provides no gold-standard facts/reasoning boundaries. This heuristic can leave pre-decision legal reasoning or remove factual material around a boundary; it must be reported as a limitation.
